title: Map positions
source: CMap::LoadPositionsFile (0x8FBB0): unit, text_position and city (FINDINGS-mapbuild.md section 7), building_position and building_nudge, handed to CMap::LoadBuildingPositions (0x90390) and LoadBuildingNudges (0x90750), and text_scale on the same switch (FINDINGS-mappoint.md section 7); CMapPoint's keys x and y (FINDINGS-mappoint.md section 2). The switch's whole case list is not in the record, so the block is inferred; text_rotation is from usage.

file.desc: where things are drawn in each province

province.desc: where things are drawn in one province

unit.desc: the unit point: where counters stand, and the pixel that decides the province's climate. Last of unit and text_position wins on a sea zone

text_position.desc: where the name is drawn; on a sea zone also the unit point

building_nudge.desc: a number per building; what it does is not established

y.desc: y, in pixels, counted from the south

building_position.desc: a point per building; a key is looked up in common/buildings.txt

patterns.desc: where the building is drawn; the naval base's is checked to lie inside the province

building_nudge.desc: a number per building; a key is looked up in common/buildings.txt

patterns.desc: the building's nudge; nothing in the mod sets one
